review_kind: independent bounded public-reference and additive-inventory review
method: Independently hashed every manifest member; decompressed all 22 source artifacts and checked raw/compressed hashes and byte counts against source records and original capture receipts. Receipt absolute temporary paths resolve to the same bytes as proposed repository destinations.

Parsed captured data-pagefind-body with an independent HTMLParser; checked all 452 quote occurrences including the repeated catalog bindings. Independently compared the complete ordered 202 h4 function signatures and their h2 sections, including literal experimental/deprecated labels.
Verified all actual UTC retrieval timestamps map to September 19 America/New_York; retained September 20 UTC captures and explicit mutable-document/historical-authentication caveats.

Applied all 91 patch operations independently to git-show base bytes and compared the resulting JSON with candidate-registry. Recursively checked every prior value unchanged, arrays prefix-preserved, no replaced map keys, and only additive changes after version test.
Checked 187 unique leaf IDs, all dependencies resolve and graph is acyclic; all 14 added leaves remain planned only with acceptance not_bound. All function required_leaf and binding IDs resolve.

Read 26 compatibility/lifecycle qualifications and nine limitations against captured sources; preserved material distinctions between sheet actions and Ontology writeback, presence/history and concurrency, import/export and round-trip fidelity, beta security envelopes and universal availability.
limitations: Approval covers this bounded addition only, not exhaustive F09 or Foundry inventory, executable compatibility, implementation, workflow acceptance, production qualification, or release.
Reference freeze remains partial_snapshot; all previous blocker and state values are preserved.
Acceptance commands, fixtures and owning boundary for these new leaves remain unbound.
The source artifact copies and exact proposal/candidate custody must be retained when root applies the addition; this review does not establish later committed artifact custody.
No runtime product tests were executed in this reference review.
